name: A Curse of Snow
source:
It’s the night of your wedding, but the idea of an arranged marriage chases you into the woods, searching for answers—only to find a beautiful ice palace adorned with stunning frozen sculptures and an alluring Snow Queen. As far as you know, this is the first you’ve met, but her tone is all-too familiar which both comforts and unsettles you. Can her words sway you to stay by her side or will you choose to return to your betrothed?

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/a-curse-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你的婚礼之​​夜，但包办婚姻的想法却将你追赶到树林中，寻找答案，却发现一座美丽的冰宫，装饰着令人惊叹的冰冻雕塑和迷人的冰雪女王。据你所知，这是你第一次见面，但她的语气太熟悉了，这让你既感到安慰又感到不安。她的话能否让你留在她身边，或者你会选择回到你的未婚夫身边？

[来自[url=https://floramisu.itch.io/a-curse-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
